name: General LGV Lemma: r×r Lindström-Gessel-Viennot Determinant

insights: Parent OQ03 (2878 lines, 0 axioms, 0 sorries) proves the 2×2 LGV lemma completely
General r×r LGV: non-intersecting r-tuples = det[[e(Ai,Bj)]] for i,j = 1..r
Proof for r×r requires sign-reversing involution on r-tuples of paths
Algebraic bridge proved: det(pathMatrix) = sum_sigma sign(sigma) * card(PermPathTuple)
pathMN_card proved via double induction + Pascal identity + splitting equiv
GV cancellation requires well-formedness: ∀ i j, sources i ≤ targets j
FIXED: NonIntersecting definition was incomplete - half-open intervals missed entry points and trailing North steps. Now uses closed intervals + final column with n₁,n₂ params.
PROVED: lattice_paths_must_cross via discrete IVT (crossing_column_exists using Finset.max') + colEntry monotonicity
colEntry_mono proved: colEntry is non-decreasing (from northBeforeEast_mono)
colEntry_le_north proved: colEntry P.val k ≤ n for PathMN m n
Crossing lemma proof: (1) final column first disjunct contradicts hend, (2) second disjunct gives p(m)>q(m), (3) IVT finds crossing, (4) colEntry monotonicity kills both disjointness options
GV cancellation reduces to 2 sub-goals: (1) card_nonCancellable = niTupleCount (bijection), (2) cancellable part sums to 0 (involution)
isNonCancellable/IsGVFixedPoint: NI identity tuples have weight 1 (sign(id)=1)
Finset.sum_involution in Mathlib proves sum=0 for involution with no fixed points, need Finset.sum_filter_add_sum_filter_not to separate fixed pts
PermPathTuple cfg 1 is definitionally PathTuple cfg (σ=1 means target(σ(i))=target(i))
The involution must work at element level (not permutation level) because crossing points depend on specific path choices
Proved card_nonCancellable_eq_niTupleCount: the counting bijection between {⟨1,p⟩ | NI(p)} and {p : PathTuple | NI(p)} via Fintype.card_congr
take_at_column_entry: at column entry position x+colEntry(l,x), prefix has exactly x East steps (proved by induction on path list)
take_east_count_within_column: generalizes to any position within a column (proved by induction, same structure)
cancellable_has_crossing: every cancellable tagged tuple has a crossing pair (i<j) — proved by case split on σ=1 vs σ≠1
GV involution structure: crossingI/crossingJ extract the canonical crossing pair, gvNewPerm gives the transposed permutation
Sign reversal: sign(swap(i,j)*σ) = -sign(σ) follows from map_mul + sign_swap + one_mul
No fixed points: if gvInvolutionFn(t)=t then swap(i,j)=1 contradicting i<j, proved via eval at crossingI
Self-inverse key insight: tail swap only changes paths AFTER the crossing point, so prefix is preserved, and the same crossing pair is found on re-application
CRITICAL: GV involution must use RIGHT multiplication σ*swap(i,j), not LEFT swap(i,j)*σ — left gives σ'(i)=swap(σ(i)) which does not match tail swap endpoints
Separating gvSwappedPaths from gvInvolutionFn allows gvInvolutionFn_fst = rfl even with sorry'd paths
mkSwappedPathMN: prefix has x₀ East steps, suffix has m-x₀ — concatenation preserves total East count m
